submission.justification: No project document gives a GWP100 value for any candidate, so the hard GWP ≤ 150 limit is unverified for all three. G2 is the standard fluorinated mixture and almost certainly exceeds the limit. G3 only partly substitutes the fluorinated component, so it probably exceeds the limit too. G1 is based on newer replacement gases and is the most likely to comply, but this is an inference, not a documented fact. I picked G1 as the safer choice for the hard constraint. It has the worst time resolution of the three: 2.05 ns at 2 mm, against 1.49–1.55 ns for G3 and 0.9 ns for G2 in the 2025 summary. Among the G1 gaps I simulated, 2 mm was best (1 mm: 2.32 ns, 3 mm: 2.25 ns). The GWP values must be confirmed before this choice is final. If G3 turns out to comply, it would be the better pick, at about 1 mm (1.49 ns).

requirements.requirement: Mixture is one of the three candidates

requirements.evidence: No document states GWP values. G1 is assumed compliant because it uses newer replacement gases. This is unverified.
G1 at 2 mm gives 2.047 ns in simulation. G3 gives 1.49 ns at 1 mm, and G2 gave 0.9 ns at 2 mm in 2025. This was traded off against the hard GWP constraint.
